meta.title: Wong Tai Sin Fortune Sticks - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Wong Tai Sin fortune sticks consist of one hundred sticks. Traditionally, one states their name and birth date before drawing, and may ask about anything, with the stick text used to judge fortune.
desc: Wong Tai Sin fortune sticks consist of one hundred sticks. Traditionally, one states their name and birth date before drawing, and may ask about anything, with the stick text used to judge fortune.
ui.1: Mentally state your name and your question, be respectful and sincere, then draw a stick.
ui.2: The data in this tool comes from public traditional culture materials and is for entertainment reference only.
